bibliographic.title: Automation of Systematic Reviews with Large Language Models

relevance_to_mlgg: End-to-end SR automation: 93.1% extraction accuracy vs human 79.7%. Uses o3-mini-high for extraction with blinded adjudication. Reproduced 12 Cochrane reviews in 2 days (= 12 work-years). Direct benchmark for MLGG extraction accuracy.
key_methods: GPT-4.1 screening agent + o3-mini-high extraction agent
key_findings: Extraction accuracy: otto-SR 93.1% vs human 79.7% vs Elicit 74.8%
Blinded panel sided with otto-SR in 69.3% of discrepancies
0.6% of errors from inaccessible data, 0.67% from parsing errors, 0.49% from extraction errors
actionable_for_mlgg: Benchmark target: MLGG extraction should aim for >90% accuracy on test set
Blinded adjudication protocol for resolving extraction disagreements
Variable description prompting: describe each field in extraction prompt
